items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So that’s when Bill Graham came, Bill Graham was a baritone player that came with Dizzy. It was a quintet at that time with Al Jones…

ctx.x: Yeah, and he was just trying to drink and come off his addiction. And Dizzy didn’t want anyone in the band to have anything to do with drugs like that, with heroin, ‘cause his experience with Charlie Parker and what not, he just didn’t want it around him. So that’s when Bill Graham came, Bill Graham was a baritone player that came with Dizzy. It was a quintet at that time with Al Jones…
